purpose: Teach: 迷わ/掴む/乗れる/はやく/はやり/思い出せ/逃げ出し/見落とし

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、迷わ、絶対、ないで、絶対、進路、絶対、決めろよ
lines.en: Riku — you need to commit. Pick your path already. Seriously.
lines.style: Sharp and direct, leaning into his space. Quick rhythm, no room for hedging. The tone of someone pushing a friend toward something they know he can do.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、観客の心、本気で、絶対、掴む、絶対、プレー、絶対、すげえな、桜
lines.en: You've got this thing where you just read the room perfectly. The way you play — it's incredible, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, slower cadence. Lean back slightly, like he's letting the observation land. Warm but still measured — not performing emotion.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、ノリに、絶対、乗れる、絶対、奴だよな
lines.en: You're the kind of person who just vibes with whatever's happening. That's what makes you you.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost affectionate. Quick energy returning. Not quite a compliment, more like stating a fact she should already know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、はやく、絶対、宿題終わらせろよ、桜
lines.en: Come on — finish your homework already. Stop dragging it out.
lines.style: Gentle nudge wrapped in exasperation. Not unkind. The rhythm of someone who's said this before and will say it again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、はやり、絶対、の音楽、絶対、聴いてんな
lines.en: Wait — you've been listening to that trendy stuff now? Really?
lines.style: Caught off-guard, curious lift at the end. Teasing edge underneath. Leaning in like he's genuinely trying to picture it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、思い出せ、絶対、よ、絶対、昨日の約束、桜
lines.en: You remember what you promised me yesterday, right? Don't play dumb.
lines.style: Low and steady, with weight. Not angry — just making sure it lands. The kind of thing you say when you know the answer matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストで、本気で、絶対、逃げ出し、絶対、たくなったろ?本気で
lines.en: You wanted to bolt during that test, didn't you? Be honest.
lines.style: Playful accusation, quick rhythm. A knowing smirk underneath the words. Pulling at something he knows is there.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、見落とし、絶対、た、絶対、問題、絶対、あったろ、桜
lines.en: You definitely missed a question in there though. Don't act like you caught everything.
lines.style: Wry, almost droll. Slight smile in the voice. Not mean — just pointing out what they both know is true.
